source_text: Exempla divina informant: Moyses verum pascha Christum immolandum sciebat, ovem tamen corporalem mandavit; azymos sinceritatis intellexit, farinae azymos praecepit. Ita sancta sanctorum verbis communibus velata traduntur. Humeri operum indicium sunt. Ecclesiasticae observationes similiter — quae omnibus agenda, quorum ratio paucis innotescit. Portamus velata donec digni revelata facie contemplemur.
pass_a_gloss: Examples divine inform: Moses true passover Christ to-be-sacrificed knew, sheep however bodily ordered; unleavened of-sincerity understood, of-flour unleavened commanded. Thus holy of-holies by-words common veiled are-handed. Shoulders of-works sign are. Ecclesiastical observances likewise — which by-all to-be-done, whose reason to-few becomes-known. We-carry veiled-things until worthy with-unveiled face we-may-contemplate.
pass_b_english: Divine examples teach the same. Moses knew Christ must be sacrificed as true Passover, yet ordered a bodily sheep; he understood the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth, yet commanded flour’s unleavened loaves. So the holy of holies is handed on veiled in common speech. Shoulders signify works. Church observances are alike — deeds required of all, whose reason few yet know. We carry them veiled until, made worthy, we contemplate with unveiled face.
